notes: Iteration-2 assertions were sharpened (outcome-level checks, final-message length, internal Conformists, cycle handling, proportionate critics); scores are not directly comparable with iteration 1.
Fix 1 worked: validate mode used 2 critics (1 flagged context + 1 map pass) instead of 13, and the unconfirmed relationship was resolved by asking. Tokens 154k -> 121k, time 488s -> 430s.
Fix 3 worked: final messages 247-319 words (baselines 395-957); the map question was a plain yes/no.

Fix 2 over-corrected in eval 2: to break cycles, two link flips contradict stated facts (Scheduling made upstream of Trust & Safety although Scheduling needs T&S's eligibility answer), confirmed only by improvised expert answers. Needs a guard: never flip against a fact the expert stated; ask neutral, not leading, questions.
Remaining cost leaks: eval 1 re-ran all 8 context critics in round 2 (only 3 needed); facilitator messages 670-850 words with 7-9 questions per round.

Caveats: eval-1 baseline read velocity/CLAUDE.md (names reference contexts); simulated expert answers vary between runs; token counts exclude nested critic/expert subagents; one run per configuration.
